description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for searching and filtering job title data within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It extends a base filter parameters class and adds a specific property for filtering only active job titles.

classes.name: JobTitleSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters for job titles, including active-only filtering and sortable fields.

methods.name: getActiveOnly
methods.description: Retrieves the filter indicating whether to include only active job titles.

methods.name: setActiveOnly
methods.description: Sets the filter to include only active job titles.
